Overview

The economics of Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Public Sector & Government flipped in the last two years: runtimes got durable, evaluation became routine, and orchestration frameworks matured into something you can run under change control. What separates winners now is integration discipline — how cleanly the capability plugs into case & benefits platforms without inventing a shadow estate. In Public Sector & Government the constraints are structural, not cosmetic: GDPR / privacy regimes shapes what data may move, service standards dominates the economics, and any capability that cannot explain its own decisions will be switched off by risk committees. The architecture reflects all three from the first commit.
